stanzas.sanskrit:
बलसमेतबलानुगतो भवान्
पुरमगाहत भीष्मकमानितः ।
द्विजसुतं त्वदुपागमवादिनं
धृतरसा तरसा प्रणनाम सा ॥ ७९-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Balaram followed Krishna with an army who entered Kundina kingdom and were respectfully received by King Bhishmaka. Rukmini was was overjoyed hearing the news honoured the Brahmin.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
balasametabalānugato bhavān
puramagāhata bhīṣmakamānitaḥ |
dvijasutaṃ tvadupāgamavādinaṃ
dhṛtarasā tarasā praṇanāma sā || 79-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भुवनकान्तमवेक्ष्य भवद्वपु-
-र्नृपसुतस्य निशम्य च चेष्टितम् ।
विपुलखेदजुषां पुरवासिनां
सरुदितैरुदितैरगमन्निशा ॥ ७९-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The people of Kundina saw the charming Krishna and felt sad about Rukmi's decision to give Rukmini in marriage to Shishupala. They spent entire night in sorrow.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhuvanakāntamavekṣya bhavadvapu-
-rnṛpasutasya niśamya ca ceṣṭitam |
vipulakhedajuṣāṃ puravāsināṃ
saruditairuditairagamanniśā || 79-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदनु वन्दितुमिन्दुमुखी शिवां
विहितमङ्गलभूषणभासुरा ।
निरगमद्भवदर्पितजीविता
स्वपुरतः पुरतः सुभटावृता ॥ ७९-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The next day morning, the moon faced beautiful Rukmini, dressed in her bridal dress and jewelry who’s mind, heart and soul was set on Krishna, came out of her palace with guards to go to temple to pray to Goddess Parvati.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadanu vanditumindumukhī śivāṃ
vihitamaṅgalabhūṣaṇabhāsurā |
niragamadbhavadarpitajīvitā
svapurataḥ purataḥ subhaṭāvṛtā || 79-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कुलवधूभिरुपेत्य कुमारिका
गिरिसुतां परिपूज्य च सादरम् ।
मुहुरयाचत तत्पदपङ्कजे
निपतिता पतितां तव केवलम् ॥ ७९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rukmini entered the temple with the noble women and did pooja for Goddess Parvati and prostrated at her feet. She prayed again and again that only Krishna should marry her.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kulavadhūbhirupetya kumārikā
girisutāṃ paripūjya ca sādaram |
muhurayācata tatpadapaṅkaje
nipatitā patitāṃ tava kevalam || 79-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
समवलोककुतूहलसङ्कुले
नृपकुले निभृतं त्वयि च स्थिते ।
नृपसुता निरगाद्गिरिजालया-
-त्सुरुचिरं रुचिरञ्जितदिङ्मुखा ॥ ७९-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The kings assembled outside the temple eagerly to see the beautiful princess Rukmini. Krishna was also standing along but a little away. As she came out of the temple her beauty radiated all over the place.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
samavalokakutūhalasaṅkule
nṛpakule nibhṛtaṃ tvayi ca sthite |
nṛpasutā niragādgirijālayā-
-tsuruciraṃ rucirañjitadiṅmukhā || 79-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भुवनमोहनरूपरुचा तदा
विवशिताखिलराजकदम्बया ।
त्वमपि देव कटाक्षविमोक्षणैः
प्रमदया मदयाञ्चकृषे मनाक् ॥ ७९-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rukmini’s charming beauty mesmerised the entire assembly of kings. Krishna was enchanted by her when she cast her side glance on him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhuvanamohanarūparucā tadā
vivaśitākhilarājakadambayā |
tvamapi deva kaṭākṣavimokṣaṇaiḥ
pramadayā madayāñcakṛṣe manāk || 79-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
क्व नु गमिष्यसि चन्द्रमुखीति तां
सरसमेत्य करेण हरन् क्षणात् ।
समधिरोप्य रथं त्वमपाहृथा
भुवि ततो विततो निनदो द्विषाम् ॥ ७९-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna went near her and asked where she was going to and while speaking only, HE took her hand, led her to the chariot and drove away with her. There was a loud protest from the people gathered around.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kva nu gamiṣyasi candramukhīti tāṃ
sarasametya kareṇa haran kṣaṇāt |
samadhiropya rathaṃ tvamapāhṛthā
bhuvi tato vitato ninado dviṣām || 79-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
क्व नु गतः पशुपाल इति क्रुधा
कृतरणा यदुभिश्च जिता नृपाः ।
न तु भवानुदचाल्यत तैरहो
पिशुनकैः शुनकैरिव केसरी ॥ ७९-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The angered kings searched where the cowherd boy had gone and put up a fight. They were easily defeated by Yadavas. A lion is not affected by the barking of dogs, similarly Krishna was unaffected by the enraged and evil minded kings.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kva nu gataḥ paśupāla iti krudhā
kṛtaraṇā yadubhiśca jitā nṛpāḥ |
na tu bhavānudacālyata tairaho
piśunakaiḥ śunakairiva kesarī || 79-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदनु रुक्मिणमागतमाहवे
वधमुपेक्ष्य निबध्य विरूपयन् ।
हृतमदं परिमुच्य बलोक्तिभिः
पुरमया रमया सह कान्तया ॥ ७९-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Next, angry Rukmi attacked Krishna. Krishna defeated him effortlessly but refrained from killing him by Rukmini. Krishna then tied his hands with a vasthra and shaved of his beard and hair thus humbling his pride. With request of Balarama, Krishna released Rukmi from bondage and proceeded to Dwaraka with Rukmini, who is Mahalakshmi herself.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadanu rukmiṇamāgatamāhave
vadhamupekṣya nibadhya virūpayan |
hṛtamadaṃ parimucya baloktibhiḥ
puramayā ramayā saha kāntayā || 79-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नवसमागमलज्जितमानसां
प्रणयकौतुकजृम्भितमन्मथाम् ।
अरमयः खलु नाथ यथासुखं
रहसि तां हसितांशु लसन्मुखीम् ॥ ७९-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rukmini felt shy with her union with Krishna and her joy increased with the love experienced. Being with Krishna, Rukmini's face beamed with charming smile.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
navasamāgamalajjitamānasāṃ
praṇayakautukajṛmbhitamanmathām |
aramayaḥ khalu nātha yathāsukhaṃ
rahasi tāṃ hasitāṃśu lasanmukhīm || 79-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
विविधनर्मभिरेवमहर्निशं
प्रमदमाकलयन् पुनरेकदा ।
ऋजुमतेः किल वक्रागिरा भवान्
वरतनोरतनोदतिलोलताम् ॥ ७९-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna delighted Rukmini, day and night, with HIS pleasant talks and jokes. Once, Krishna with his doubtful words teased her and made the simple, honest minded Rukmini to get agitated.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vividhanarmabhirevamaharniśaṃ
pramadamākalayan punarekadā |
ṛjumateḥ kila vakrāgirā bhavān
varatanoratanodatilolatām || 79-11 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदधिकैरथ लालनकौशलैः
प्रणयिनीमधिकं सुखयन्निमाम् ।
अयि मुकुन्द भवच्चरितानि नः
प्रगदतां गदतान्तिमपाकुरु ॥ ७९-१२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: More than ever before, Krishna delighted Rukmini with HIS adorable, charming words & gestures. Bhattathiri worshipped to Bhagwan to liberate him from the sufferings caused by the disease.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadadhikairatha lālanakauśalaiḥ
praṇayinīmadhikaṃ sukhayannimām |
ayi mukunda bhavaccaritāni naḥ
pragadatāṃ gadatāntimapākuru || 79-12 ||
